narrative: The letter, open. The letter on the table, folded, the date visible at the head, no fresh line, no broken seal. The letter, open. The same fold. A cloak beside it, ready for the afternoon. Nothing written in the margin.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the folded sheet and added nothing.

entities.name: letter
entities.context: Shown on letter in Still for today's carrier
